scripts.dev:local: cd backend && npm run dev & cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.restart: npm run stop && npm run start
scripts.reset-db: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.clean: docker compose down -v && docker system prune -f
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:json: mkdir -p test-results && USE_FAKE_AI=true playwright test --workers=80% --reporter=json > test-results/results.json
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.seed: docker exec ai-content-backend npx ts-node src/seeders/index.ts
scripts.seed:clear: docker exec ai-content-backend npx ts-node src/seeders/index.ts --clear
scripts.seed:small: docker exec ai-content-backend npx ts-node src/seeders/index.ts --count=100
scripts.seed:large: docker exec ai-content-backend npx ts-node src/seeders/index.ts --count=5000
